correctness.rationale: For every odd prime p, BCH coordinates identify the exponent-p Heisenberg group; every automorphism is (A,ell), with GL_2(p) quotient matrix A and p² central shifts. The fixed-class formula gives R=p^dimker(A-I)+(p−1)1_detA=1. Determinant-one GL_2 matrices split into k=2 (1), k=1 (p²−1), k=0 (p³−p²−p). Determinant-not-one matrices split into k=1 (p(p+1)(p−2)) and k=0 (p(p+1)(p−2)²). These disjoint cases imply four polynomial multiplicities, summing to |Aut(H_p)|. An independent twisted-action orbit count was exhaustively performed for every one of 432 automorphisms at p=3, and matrix counts for p=3,5,7,11. Finite checks are auxiliary.

originality.rationale: The novel mathematical unit is the complete four-value polynomial multiplicity histogram over all automorphisms of the order-p^3 exponent-p Heisenberg group. The R=1 count is credited as previously known, under the odd-characteristic class-two correspondence to a Heisenberg Lie algebra. Previously inspected group articles provide broad counting reductions and automorphism classifications but do not explicitly contain the entire histogram. Equivalence and stronger-coverage searches found no decisive prior full distribution; a prior implicit derivation remains a real residual risk.

value.rationale: The Reidemeister spectrum with multiplicities is a natural whole-group structural invariant, not an arbitrary slice. The complete distribution over an infinite parameter family distinguishes generic fixed-free behavior from unipotent and determinant-one exceptional strata, supplies exact numerical data for all automorphisms, and goes beyond the known fixed-free row. No downstream theorem is presumed.
